bounded_host_request.command:
set -u
target='theGreatOldDaysofNipponGV'
unit=''
while IFS= read -r candidate; do
 [ -n "$candidate" ] || continue
 body="$(systemctl --user cat "$candidate" 2>/dev/null || true)"
 if printf '%s' "$body" | grep -Fqi "$target"; then
  [ -z "$unit" ] || exit 90
  unit="$candidate"
 fi
done < <(systemctl --user list-unit-files --type=service --no-legend --plain 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $1}')
[ -n "$unit" ] || exit 91
pid="$(systemctl --user show "$unit" --property=MainPID --value)"
[ "$pid" -gt 0 ] || exit 92
test -r "/proc/$pid/io" || exit 93
measure() { awk '/^(rchar|wchar|read_bytes|write_bytes):/{s+=$2}END{printf "%.0f",s}' "/proc/$pid/io" 2>/dev/null; }
a="$(measure)"
sleep 4
b="$(measure)"
test -n "$a" && test -n "$b" || exit 94
if [ "$b" -gt "$a" ]; then exit 95; fi
exit 96
